caption: This drawing depicts a sepia-toned, brown wooden writing desk with turned legs, featuring a fold-down front panel that acts as a writing surface, revealing a central set of small compartments and pigeonholes inside. The main image is centered on the page, while the drawing is bordered with a thin, straight black line framing the entire composition. In each corner, separate outlined boxes contain additional drawings or icons: the upper left box shows a single key with an ornate handle, the upper right box depicts a keyhole with a metallic sheen, the lower left box includes a front view of the closed desk with the panel upright and a single drawer beneath, and the lower right box displays a side view of the desk with the writing surface extended. The background is light beige, and the entire composition is rendered in shades of brown, with detailed linework and subtle shading for depth.
title: School-master's desk
